standard.summary: RS-LoRA 将输出缩放从 alpha/rank 改为 alpha/√rank，减缓缩放随 rank 增大而下降的速度；不保证跨 rank 的学习率或画质相同。
standard.effect: 相同 alpha、rank 和 A/B 权重下，RS-LoRA 的输出缩放是标准 LoRA 的 √rank 倍。切换后仍可能需要调整 alpha 或学习率。
standard.whenToUse: 需要比较不同 rank 的缩放策略时可考虑，尤其是高 rank；对照时同时记录 alpha、初始化和学习率。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要在沿用标准 LoRA 配方时直接开启并假设输出幅度、收敛速度和画质不变。

standard_en.summary: RS-LoRA changes output scaling from alpha/rank to alpha/sqrt(rank), slowing its decrease as rank grows. It does not guarantee equal learning rates or image quality across ranks.
standard_en.effect: For identical alpha, rank and A/B weights, RS-LoRA output scaling is sqrt(rank) times standard LoRA scaling. Switching may still require adjusting alpha or learning rate.
standard_en.whenToUse: Consider it when comparing scaling strategies across ranks, especially at high rank. Record alpha, initialization and learning rate alongside rank.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable it on a standard LoRA recipe while assuming unchanged output magnitude, convergence speed or image quality.

advanced.principle: 固定 alpha 时，标准 LoRA 的 scaling 按 1/rank 下降，RS-LoRA 按 1/√rank 下降。输出缩放不等于优化器的有效步长；A/B 初始化、优化器和学习率分组也影响更新。
advanced.intervention: 修改 LoRA forward 中的 scaling 因子：scaling = alpha / sqrt(rank) 替代 alpha / rank。
advanced.expectedImpact: 提供另一种随 rank 变化的缩放方式。是否改善收敛或画质取决于模型、数据和配方，本项目没有通用的质量提升百分比。
advanced.tradeoffs: LoRA+ 调整 A/B 学习率分组，RS-LoRA 调整输出缩放；两者作用不同，组合后仍需检查配方，不能把标准同学习率的 rank 迁移规则直接套用。

advanced_en.principle: With fixed alpha, standard LoRA scaling decreases as 1/rank and RS-LoRA as 1/sqrt(rank). Output scaling is not the optimizer's effective step size; A/B initialization, optimizer and learning-rate groups also affect updates.
advanced_en.intervention: Modifies the scaling factor in the LoRA forward: scaling = alpha / sqrt(rank) instead of alpha / rank.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Provides a different scaling rule across ranks. Convergence and image-quality effects depend on the model, data and recipe; this project has no universal quality-gain percentage.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: LoRA+ changes A/B learning-rate groups while RS-LoRA changes output scaling. Their combination still needs recipe validation; rank-transfer rules derived for equal A/B learning rates do not directly establish its behavior.
